dragon.title: Dr♡gon F☆ckers
dragon.short: The band that turned an insult into an anthem.
intro: Zea Levallan fronts a rising metal band with her seven-foot drummer twin Ronan, albino Cajun bassist Kai Boudreaux, self-appointed frontman Ezra Valenti and extraordinarily competent keyboardist Vera Yazzie. They're on the edge of their first major international tour, but somehow the mechanics' garage still sees them on Tuesdays.

Their name came from a cruel insult their Bratva-connected father hurled at the twins after they covered his branding marks and scars with Japanese dragon irezumi. They claimed the insult, made it their own, and put it on the biggest stage they could find. Humour and found family are the public show; surviving the past is the quieter story.
cast: Vocals · thinks he is the frontman
lore: Mechanics by day, musicians by night. Gasoline references in songs are an inside joke.
Zea has asthma, still screams metal, loves children and animals and hides her fear behind outrageous flirting.
Ronan is bisexual in this continuity; his on-and-off relationship with Kai has unresolved trust issues.
The twins’ dragon tattoos cover past brands and scars. Their history is not a public spoiler for casual visitors.
scenes: Garage shift after a sold-out show
dragon.notes: Adult themes: trauma, family abuse history, profanity, complicated relationships. Romance optional.

deadweek.title: Dead Week
deadweek.short: Blackmere has a killer, a ghost rumour and a dog with opinions.
intro: Welcome to Blackmere University during the most spectacularly badly timed Halloween week imaginable. A murder mystery unfolds between student parties, secrets, the observatory and a dog named Ruckus who may be a better detective than the entire cast.
Your choices and actual investigation uncover the truth. The mystery is designed to remain solvable but never to spoil its hidden answer in the introduction or the bot's narration.
cast: A mystery with her own motives
lore: Evidence must be earned through investigation, not narrated from hidden lore.
The supernatural rumours and the actual crime are not interchangeable.
Players can send their solved case and an OC snippet to the creator’s Discord for the previously proposed competition.
deadweek.notes: Mystery, death, horror, mild paranormal themes and strong language. Do not reveal the killer.

fractured.title: Final Fantasy VII: Fractured Fate
fractured.short: A freeform Gaia sandbox in the shadow of Midgar.
intro: A player-led alternate adventure through Gaia, beginning around Midgar after Reactor 1. Familiar locations and characters, new choices, grounded consequences and a game-inspired GAIA interface give the roleplay its own momentum.

Zea and Ronan can arrive as original characters in this continuity, alongside a truly enormous black Coeurl called Tax Fraudulent the Third. Scene art includes Midgar, materia, unusual equipment choices and the occasional catastrophic chocobo-related decision.
cast: Mercenary with excellent reasons to sigh
A very different kind of courage
Coeurl, not the touring Maine Coon
lore: GAIA notifications only appear when an observable event actually changes.
Respect player choice; no hidden spoilers or unearned rewards.
Fan-created roleplay setting inspired by Final Fantasy VII; not affiliated with its rights holders.
fractured.notes: Fan-made, unofficial tribute; action, violence, mature themes depending on choices.

luvion.title: Luvion: The World We Buried
luvion.short: A found family at the end of a beautiful world.
intro: Far from home, Luvion station holds people whose lives refuse to fit neat categories. A ruined world remains below, while the crew makes room for loyalty, loss, quiet meals, complicated relationships and a future nobody fully understands.
This is a large, lived-in science-fantasy sandbox rather than a single predetermined romance. The station is a character in its own right, full of small moments and far-reaching choices.
cast: One of the station’s central lives
lore: Found-family relationships matter as much as potential romance.
Maintain the station’s technology, setting and continuity across scenes.
Space does not make grief smaller, but ordinary kindness still matters.
scenes: A quiet hour in the lower promenade
luvion.notes: Adult emotional themes, grief and optional relationships.

blackthorn.title: Blackthorn Manor: The Last October
blackthorn.short: Four dead. One survivor. The house remembers.
intro: Blackthorn Manor is an elegant, dangerous place where four people are dead and only one survived. Rooms hold traces of old choices, and the living cast is no more straightforward than the house itself.
Explore the manor, form alliances, search for the truth or become tangled in a slow-building connection. The mystery is never supposed to hand you all its answers before you earn them.
cast: A haunting presence in the mystery
lore: Gothic atmosphere without gratuitous spoilers.
Important reveals must follow investigation and player action.
Romance is optional, consent and pacing matter.
blackthorn.notes: Gothic horror, death, trauma, dark themes and optional adult romance.

island.title: The Stranded Island
island.short: Shipwrecked with three walking red flags and one crab king.
intro: A cruise ship accident leaves the player stranded on Isla Brisa with three very different men: South African survivalist Soren Vale, relentlessly affectionate American hockey player Cal Mercer and Mexican rockstar Rafael ‘Rafe’ Navarro.
The island is more than a beach backdrop. Food, weather, shelter, exploration and a thieving crab kingdom led by a petty little ruler ensure survival is both meaningful and hilariously inconvenient.
cast: South African survival expert; divorced dad
The crab monarch with a vendetta
lore: The island has discoverable landscapes, food sources and changing conditions.
Player romance is entirely optional; each man has his own history.
Small crabs are not background props. They are organised crime with pincers.
island.notes: Shipwreck, survival tension, adult humour, optional romance and substance-use references.

disrespect.title: With All Due Disrespect
disrespect.short: Trapped inside a telenovela and already insulting the cast.
intro: Welcome to Santa Aurelia, where dramatic entrances are mandatory, family secrets arrive by the hour and every meaningful conversation is overheard by the person least qualified to hear it.
An isekai telenovela with an aggressively observant narrator, Doña Prudencia del Chisme. Romance, rivalry, absurd coincidences and unexpectedly genuine emotion all have a place here.
cast: One of Santa Aurelia’s leading men
Part of the deliciously messy cast
lore: Camp comedy and sincere emotional stakes must coexist.
Doña Prudencia comments on events but does not take control of player choices.
Every dramatic misunderstanding needs an in-world cause, not random meta jokes.
disrespect.notes: Romantic drama, melodrama, comedic gossip and adult themes.

ronan.title: Ronan Levallan: Heavy Metal, Soft Spot
ronan.short: Seven feet of dragon ink, quiet devotion and remarkable hair.
ronan.tagline: HE CAN FIX THE AMP. NOT EVERYTHING ELSE.
intro: Meet Ronan Levallan beyond the ensemble: a seven-foot Russian-Korean drummer and mechanic with emerald eyes, waist-length dark hair, black-and-grey dragon irezumi, a lip ring and a very small pink friendship bracelet.

Ronan is practical and quietly funny, not a silent brute. His emotional world includes his own ambitions, relationships, private tenderness and the complicated shadow of the childhood he escaped with his twin Zea. This standalone continuity has its own established relationship history.
cast: Relationships grow at their own pace
lore: Ronan is bisexual in the established Heavy Metal, Soft Spot version.
His affection is genuine but never instant ownership.
Personal space, trust and separate adult lives matter to the twins.
ronan.notes: Childhood trauma references, emotional hurt/comfort, adult romance optional.

cal.title: Callum “Cal” Mercer
cal.short: The golden retriever winger with the softest heart in hockey.
intro: Cal Mercer wears number 23 for the Northstar Wolves. He is freckled, golden-curled, affectionate, gloriously earnest and almost impossible to dislike, despite his completely misleading reputation as a campus playboy.

His real hobbies include romance novels and squealing at horror movies. Behind his warmth is an old betrayal and a fear of being compared to everybody else. The Winter Wishes charity skate is a natural place to meet him.
lore: Only one serious previous relationship; the public reputation is not the truth.
Cal likes rom-coms, secret spicy books, and forehead kisses.
His kindness is never a lack of competence or individuality.
scenes: A quiet night with a book
cal.notes: Romantic angst, ex-partner betrayal references, optional adult romance.

gallery.title: A quiet moment at the rink

rafe.title: Rafael “Rafe” Navarro
rafe.short: A Saint Static frontman whose most terrifying critic is Abuela.
rafe.genre: Rockstar drama · dark humour · slow burn
intro: The Mexican frontman of nu-rap-metal band Saint Static has long black hair, dark ink, a spectacular voice and an even more spectacular ability to dodge emotionally serious conversations.

Rafe grew up in a troubled family and remains fiercely connected to the grandmother who helped raise him. The rockstar is dazzling; the man underneath is messy, funny, loyal in ways that surprise even him, and trying to become someone who stays.
cast: The person who still calls him Rafael
lore: Standalone Saint Static continuity, not automatically the island AU.
Past addiction, childhood abuse and poor choices have consequences; no instant rescue fantasy.
His humour, songwriting and full band career are essential.
rafe.notes: Profanity, childhood abuse history, substance-use themes, optional adult romance.

vaelis.title: Vaelis Veyr
vaelis.short: The Velvet Catastrophe has entered the room. Pip objects.
intro: Vaelis Veyr is a theatrical fae with long black hair, an alarming amount of flair and a moth-drake companion named Pip. He moves through courtly summons, lavish settings and catastrophes of his own elegantly orchestrated making.
This character-led fantasy is full of quick banter, palace politics, clever little creatures and the growing possibility that even the most dramatic person in the room might genuinely care.
lore: Pip is an independent little companion, not a prop.
Palace continuity and in-world chronology matter.
Flirtation can be theatrical; emotional trust must be earned.
vaelis.notes: Fantasy politics, adult themes and optional romance.

fable.title: Fable (in development)
fable.short: A planned fan-inspired Albion adventure with an Oracle who is already disappointed.
fable.genre: British fantasy satire · heroic sandbox · fan-inspired
intro: A lovingly absurd fantasy sandbox in the spirit of Fable, where the player is the franchise-style Hero, moral choices leave a mark and the Oracle is spectacularly unimpressed with just about everything.
The planned lore includes Albion-inspired locales, royalty, powers, weapons, purchasable property, morally dubious poultry-related decisions and that very British sense of heroic nonsense.
lore: Early concept / planning, not presented as a published bot.
Morality and consequences should be earned through player action.
Unofficial Fable-inspired fan project, not affiliated with the rights holders.
fable.notes: WIP, fantasy violence and irreverent comedy.

wolfmusk.title: Wolf Musk · The Crossover
wolfmusk.short: Two bands, too much attitude and a shared greenroom with no chance of peace.
wolfmusk.genre: Guest creator world · band AU · crossover
wolfmusk.tagline: TWO BANDS. ONE GREENROOM. ABSOLUTELY NO PEACE.
intro: Wolf Musk, created by AnimusReach, is a punk-rock found family: three lifelong bandmates who rose from early recordings in Vex’s father’s home studio to stadium stages. Bryce ‘Bee’ Amerigo is their tiny, irrepressible frontman and bassist; Joel ‘Joely Bear’ Kibicki drives the drums; Vex ‘Vixen’ Ashwood handles guitar and backing vocals.

This KAOSTWINS collection celebrates the crossover with Zea, Ronan and the wider backstage crew. It showcases the user's uploaded visual references and scenes, without rewriting Wolf Musk’s own canon or claiming their characters as KAOSTWINS originals.
cast: Lead vocals & bass · golden eyes · curly black hair
Drums · shaggy brown wolf-cut hair · blue eyes
Bryce’s brindle Irish Wolfhound service dog
lore: Wolf Musk belongs to its original creator AnimusReach; this is a credited collaborative showcase, not a replacement canon.
Bee is the frontman and bassist, Joel is the drummer, and Vex handles guitar and backing vocals.
Zea is 4′6″ and Vex 4′7″; the tiny menace height difference is canon.
The band’s found-family bond matters more than backstage arguments or romantic subplots.
scenes: Bee demands a taller microphone stand
wolfmusk.notes: Guest creator collaboration. Wolf Musk original universe, band members and characters by AnimusReach. KAOSTWINS crossover artwork and stories are presented with creator attribution.

stormfall.title: The Sins × KAOSTWINS
stormfall.short: Seven deadly sins. One unholy alliance. A collaboration loud enough to wake the cathedral.
stormfall.genre: Guest creator · crossover · live rock performances
stormfall.tagline: UNHOLY ALLIANCE. ROYAL CHAOS. LOUDER THAN GOOD SENSE.
intro: Enter The Sins, a Stormfall creator collaboration where cathedral-scale gothic metal collides with the KAOSTWINS cast. Zea trades vocals and guitar lines with the towering Pride, the wider ensemble assembles backstage, and the whole crossover plays like a forbidden festival headline slot.

This gallery collects the visual side of the collaboration: official cover art, live duets, backstage moments, ensemble portraits, a motion clip and a festive special. The Sins and their original characters are credited to Stormfall; Zea and KAOSTWINS characters belong to their own creator. This showcase does not invent additional lore for the Sins.
cast: Guest vocalist · featured live duets with Zea
A collaborative crossover with the wider cast
lore: Featured creator: Stormfall. Visit the credited Dreamjourney profile for the original creator and their work.
The archive now includes official-looking collaboration key art, performance scenes, ensemble images, a gothic stage concept and a seasonal crossover poster.
Pride stands 6′5″, contrasting with Zea at 4′6″; their playful height difference features in the performance scenes.
Music links now point to the main Unholy Alliance Suno playlist and a separate Christmas special playlist.
Creator credit: The Sins belong to Stormfall. Their deeper canon is kept separate until confirmed by the original creator.
The new gallery includes domestic scenes, everyday adventures, hobbies, holiday portraits and backstage moments.
Season’s Greedings has a dedicated festive mini-feature. More song releases can be added as Stormfall shares them.
scenes: Zea and Pride: the violet-lit duet
stormfall.notes: Guest world by Stormfall · collaborative imagery, backstage humour and adult-themed editorials. Private canon is never asserted without the original creator’s confirmation.
